name: Mori Ogai
source:
The landlord of your boarding house. In his spare time, he works as a military doctor for the Meiji government. He might have some connection to your past...?

"No way~. I already told you that I hate troublesome things, didn't I?" 

[Translated from [url=https://p-one.site/bakumeiroku/characters/#mori]official website[/url]]
